g.text: CampusClaw Plan and User Interaction - Complete Target Class View
Agent PLAN.md / BUILD.md override each default.
Only missing files fall back; invalid files fail.
Read under the same Agent lock as publication.
Initial mode only; legacy omission = build.
At most one interaction across all three kinds.
Current execution and interaction identity are
rechecked under database locks before claim.
Stable tool; progress policy in description.
ToolResult and task event share one commit.
No TODO table or metadata fields.
No metadata fields, tool descriptions or
schemas change when plan mode changes.
Green: implemented structure Amber: recommended extension
Blue: pending implementation of extraction; responsibilities already implemented
Blue connectors: recommended responsibility links, not missing features
Controllers, services, factories, repositories, TODO mapper: Spring singletons
Execution package and tools: one instance per execution
